class.name: GiantFootsteps3D
class.brief_description: Emits a footstep signal when a giant's foot touches the ground.
class.description: Watches [member foot_bones] of a [Skeleton3D] under a [GiantBody]. A foot must lift by [member lift_height] and come back within [member contact_height] of its rest height to count as a step. Heights are in body lengths, so the same settings work at every size. Use [signal footstep] for camera shake, dust and damage.

method.name: update_feet
method.description: Checks the feet once. Called automatically every frame while the game runs.

members.member: How close to its rest height (in body metres) a lifted foot must come back to count as landing.
The names of the foot bones to watch.
How far (in body metres) a foot must rise before its next landing counts.

signal.name: footstep
signal.description: Emitted when a foot lands. [param position] is the point on the ground under the foot, in world space, and [param giant_height] is the giant's height in metres, a good guide for how hard to shake things.
